newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's SMHL issues A$150 mln bonds - CSFB.
newsitem.headline: Australia's SMHL issues A$150 mln bonds - CSFB.

text.p: Superannuation Members' Home Loans (SMHL) is issuing an A$150 million securitised bond issue, lead manager Credit Suisse First Boston Australia said on Monday.
This is the fifth issue of SMHL mortgaged backed bond issue programme and would be priced on June 10 for settlement on June 13.
Macquarie Bank Ltd is co-manager on the issue, which would be rated AAA by Standard and Poor's and Aaa by Moody's Investor Service.

SMHL has reduced its lending rate to borrowers to 6.6 percent in response to the recent cut in official interest rates and, as with the previous cut, SMHL has passed on the full benefit to borrowers, it said in statement.
Executive Director of SMHL, Anthony Wamsteker said that SMHL could sustain its mortgage rate below other lenders due to its low cost structure.
There are now four million borrowers qualified to borrow under the programme with anticipated expanding demand for the product among participating superannuation fund members.
